name: Prodigi layflat photo book 297x297 mm (11.7 in)
notes: From Prodigi's layflat print guide (2026-11-20): single pages at book size, no bleed or crop marks (Prodigi adds them), 10 mm safe margin on outer edges, 18-122 pages in even counts. Unconfirmed until a test order: the exact SKU; whether the page range counts the covers (the guide makes PDF page 1 the front cover and the last page the back cover, which this pipeline does not draw yet, issue 5); and RGB vs PDF/X-4 output (issue 7). gutterSafeMm is this pipeline's own no-face band around the fold, not a Prodigi number.
